data.description: Badrah, Dubai Waterfront – Affordable Living, Seamless Connectivity, and a Thriving Future!

data.answer:
Al Badrah Community is a self-sustaining development within Badrah Waterfront, thoughtfully divided into four distinct zones. Developed by Nakheel, the community caters to diverse needs, ensuring a well-rounded lifestyle. 

Diaa is the primary residential zone, featuring approximately 600 townhouses and eight low-rise apartment buildings. Talla is dedicated to office spaces, providing a business-friendly environment, while Manara houses educational and civic amenities. The fourth zone, Bahaa, enhances the community experience with retail outlets and recreational facilities, making Badrah Waterfront a fully integrated destination.

Residents of Al Badrah Community enjoy a range of amenities, including a communal gymnasium and Badrah Pavilion, a 72,000 sq. ft. retail center offering supermarkets, retail stores, cafés, and restaurants. Families benefit from dedicated children’s play areas, parks, and playgrounds, fostering a vibrant and family-friendly atmosphere. With its strategic layout and extensive amenities, Badrah Nakheel ensures a comfortable and convenient lifestyle within this dynamic waterfront community.

Badrah Waterfront offers a diverse range of properties, including 2 and 3-bedroom townhouses and apartment complexes with studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom flats. A studio apartment in Badrah, Dubai Waterfront ranges from 460 sq. ft. to 471 sq. ft., while a 1-bedroom flat has a floor area of around 647 sq. ft. 2-bedroom apartments come in two layouts—one with 900 sq. ft. of covered space and another with 1,305 sq. ft. 

A 3-bedroom apartment in Badrah Nakheel is designed over 1,300 sq. ft. and includes four bathrooms. Townhouses in Al Badrah Community feature 2-bedroom duplex options with 1,210 to 1,257 sq. ft., while 3-bedroom townhouses span three floors with a covered space of 1,600 sq. ft. 

The architectural style reflects traditional Arabic designs, with well-lit, airy interiors. These residences are part of a gated community with dedicated maintenance services, ensuring a well-kept living environment.

Popular Buildings and Townhouses in Badrah Waterfront

Badrah, Dubai Waterfront is home to several well-designed residential buildings offering modern apartments and townhouses. 

These buildings feature spacious layouts, contemporary interiors, and easy access to community amenities. Some of the most popular buildings in Badrah Nakheel include:

Manara Residences

  • Offers studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments
  • Studio apartments range from 460 sq. ft. to 471 sq. ft.
  • 1-bedroom apartments cover 647 sq. ft.
  • 2-bedroom apartments are available in 900 sq. ft. and 1,305 sq. ft. layouts

Bahaa Apartments

  • Offers 2 and 3-bedroom apartments with open-plan layouts
  • 2-bedroom units range from 900 sq. ft. to 1,305 sq. ft.
  • 3-bedroom apartments span 1,300 sq. ft. with 4 bathrooms
  • Close to Badrah Pavilion, a 72,000 sq. ft. retail center with supermarkets, cafes, and shops

Diaa Townhouses

  • Features 2-bedroom duplex townhouses with a covered space of 1,210 to 1,257 sq. ft.
  • 3-bedroom townhouses are built over three floors with a total area of 1,600 sq. ft.
  • Located in a gated community with dedicated maintenance services

These buildings and townhouses in Badrah Residence, Dubai Waterfront offer an excellent mix of affordability, modern design, and access to essential facilities, making them ideal for both residents and investors.

Off-Plan Projects in Badrah, Dubai Waterfront

As a key sub-community in Dubai Waterfront, Badrah Nakheel continues to see new developments, with off-plan projects offering investment opportunities. 

These projects bring modern designs, sustainable living concepts, and premium facilities to the community, ensuring that investors and end-users have access to contemporary living spaces. With an affordable price range and promising rental yields, off-plan properties in Badrah Dubai Waterfront attract both first-time buyers and seasoned investors looking for long-term gains.

Renting a Property in Badrah Residence, Dubai Waterfront

For those looking to rent, Badrah Residence Dubai Waterfront offers budget-friendly apartments and townhouses with access to essential amenities. The community's proximity to Jebel Ali Freezone and direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) make it a convenient option for professionals and families. The well-maintained environment, dedicated maintenance services, and green open spaces add to the appeal of renting in Al Badrah Community.

Buying a Property in Badrah, Dubai

Investing in Badrah Dubai presents strong return-on-investment (ROI) potential. Studio apartments generate the highest ROI of 10.12%, while 1-bedroom flats yield 9.35%. 2-bedroom apartments offer 8.90% ROI, and 3-bedroom units see an average ROI of 6.70%. With its affordable property prices, strategic location, and steady rental demand, Badrah Waterfront is a lucrative option for investors seeking long-term value in Dubai’s growing real estate market.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Al Badrah Community?

data.answer:
Life in Al Badrah Community offers a perfect blend of tranquility, affordability, and modern conveniences. Let’s take a closer look at amenities and facilities residents get to enjoy.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Al Badrah, Dubai

As a master-planned development, Al Badrah Community ensures convenient parking facilities for its residents. Each household is allocated designated parking spaces, while additional parking is available along the side streets for both residents and visitors. This well-structured parking system enhances accessibility and convenience for those living in Badrah, Dubai Waterfront.

For public transportation, several bus stops are located just an 8-minute drive from Badrah, Dubai Waterfront. Nearby stops include Jebel Ali Bus Station 1, Dubai Ports Authority Staff Quarters 2, and Jebel Ali Free Zone Roundabout 12 – A. In total, there are 10 bus stops along the main road adjacent to the community. The nearest metro station is UAE Exchange Metro Station, situated about 14 minutes away by car, with other metro stations requiring a slightly longer commute.

Supermarkets in and Around Badrah Waterfront

Residents of Badrah Residence, Dubai Waterfront have access to several supermarkets offering daily essentials within a short drive. One of the most convenient options is Carrefour, located inside Badrah Pavilion. This large supermarket provides a wide range of groceries, fresh produce, and household essentials, ensuring a hassle-free shopping experience just 10 minutes away by car.

Another popular choice near Badrah Nakheel is Nesto Hypermarket, situated in Jebel Ali Free Zone Area (JAFZA), about 11 minutes away. While it is relatively smaller than Carrefour, it offers a quick and efficient shopping experience for those on the go. 

Additional grocery stores in and around Al Badrah, Dubai include Parco Supermarket, Zabeel Mini Supermarket, Suncity Supermarket, and Supersave Supermarket, all conveniently located within a short drive from the community.

Shopping Malls Near Badrah, Dubai Waterfront

For shopping and dining, several malls are within easy reach of Badrah, Dubai Waterfront. Landmark Retail, a small community mall in Mina Jebel Ali, offers a selection of eateries and retail outlets and is just 17 minutes away. 
Crystal Mall, another nearby option, is located 18 minutes away, providing additional shopping conveniences. For a more extensive retail experience, Ibn Battuta Mall, one of Dubai’s largest malls, features a vast range of international brands, dining options, and entertainment facilities, making it a popular shopping destination.

Schools and Nurseries in and Near Badrah

Families living in Al Badrah Community, Dubai have access to several nurseries within a short drive. Some of the top nursery options include Kinderville Early Learning Centre, British Orchard Nursery, Chubby Cheeks Nursery, and Little Scholar Nursery. These nurseries are located in Dubai Investment Park (DIP), approximately 20 minutes away via Sheikh Zayed Road (E11).

Kinderville Early Learning Centre, originating from the Kinderville Group in Canada, offers a specialized curriculum focusing on Math, Science, English, and Physical Activity. Meanwhile, British Orchard Nursery and Chubby Cheeks Nursery are among the most popular nursery chains in Dubai, known for their well-structured early learning programs.

For primary and secondary education, residents of Badrah, Dubai can choose from reputable schools nearby. The Arbor School, located 22 minutes away in Al Furjan, follows the British curriculum from Foundation Stage to Year 11 and emphasizes ecological preservation and sustainability in its teaching approach. 

Other well-regarded schools near Al Badrah Community include Dove Green Private School, Durham School Dubai, and Delhi Private School Dubai, all offering high-quality education and modern facilities for students.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Badrah, Dubai

Residents of Badrah Nakheel have access to several mosques, churches, and temples within a short drive. The nearest mosque is Jebel Ali Mosque 1, located just 11 minutes away, while Emirates Station Mosque is a 10-minute drive from the community. Another nearby option is DP World Camp Mosque, which can be reached in 9 minutes, ensuring convenient prayer spaces for the Muslim community.

For Christian residents, most churches are located in Jebel Ali Village, approximately 20 minutes away. Some of the well-known churches in the area include St. Mina Coptic Orthodox Church, St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church, Covenant Hope Church, Mor Ignatius Jacobite Syrian Orthodox Cathedral Dubai, and Dubai Evangelical Church Centre. In total, Jebel Ali Village is home to around eight churches, catering to different Christian denominations.

For the Hindu and Sikh communities, Guru Nanak Darbar Sikh Gurudwara, one of the largest Sikh temples in the region, is just 18 minutes away from Badrah Nakheel. Adjacent to it is the Grand Hindu Temple, providing a place of worship for Hindu residents in Dubai.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Badrah, Dubai Waterfront

Access to quality medical care is essential, and Badrah, Dubai Waterfront offers several clinics, hospitals, and pharmacies within a short drive. Access Clinic Jafza, just 13 minutes away, provides specialized services in General Medicine, Dental, and Orthopedics. Other options include Noor Al Shefa Clinic - Jafza South (10 minutes away) and DP World Clinic NMC Polyclinic (11 minutes away), catering to various outpatient needs.

For hospital care, Aster Cedars Hospital is the closest option, located 17 minutes away, featuring fully equipped operation theatres and intensive care units. Those seeking further specialized treatment can visit Armada Surgical Centre (22 minutes away) or American Hospital Dubai Media City (23 minutes away). Pharmacies like City Pharmacy JAFZA (11 minutes away) and Aster Pharmacy (13 minutes away) ensure easy access to medications and healthcare essentials.

Location & Nearby Areas

Surrounded by a mix of residential and commercial districts, Badrah Residence, Dubai Waterfront enjoys a strategic location with easy access to key areas. To the north, Mina Jebel Ali and Jebel Ali Freezone (JAFZA) serve as major business hubs. JAFZA, a prominent free zone, allows businesses to operate without requiring a local sponsor, making it a prime destination for entrepreneurs and investors.

To the south, Dubai South is an emerging community situated next to Al Maktoum International Airport, offering future-forward developments. Meanwhile, to the west, Dubai Parks and Resorts stands as a top entertainment destination, home to world-class amusement parks and attractions. This well-connected positioning makes Badrah Residence, Dubai Waterfront an ideal place for those seeking accessibility to business, lifestyle, and leisure opportunities.

Whether it's leisure, outdoor activities, or nearby attractions, the community offers a variety of experiences for residents and visitors alike.

Restaurants

For those looking to grab a quick bite or enjoy a leisurely meal, several dining options are just a short drive away. Royal View Restaurant is a casual cafeteria known for its crispy chicken burgers, sandwiches, and refreshing fresh juices, making it a great spot for a quick and satisfying meal.

For a more diverse menu, Seafarers Bar & Kitchen offers a mix of American and Italian dishes along with a full bar, perfect for a relaxed evening out. Located just 10 minutes away, it’s a go-to spot for those craving comfort food and a lively atmosphere. For an upscale experience, White Orchid Restaurant and Lounge, 13 minutes away, provides a refined dining setting with a menu that blends international flavors with elegant presentation. Whether it's a casual snack or a fine dining experience, there's something for every palate.

Beaches Near Badrah Nakheel

For a relaxing day by the sea, a few scenic beaches are just a short drive away. Jebel Ali Beach, located 13 minutes away, is an all-weather beach perfect for outdoor enthusiasts. It’s a popular spot for kitesurfing and other water sports, making it a great destination for adventure seekers.

For those looking for a more laid-back experience, XO Beach is another excellent option, just 16 minutes away. Whether it’s sunbathing, swimming, or enjoying water activities, these nearby beaches offer a refreshing escape from city life.

Hotels Around Badrah, Dubai

Visitors and business travelers have several hotel options near Badrah, Dubai Waterfront, offering comfort and convenience. JA Beach Hotel, just 15 minutes away, is a popular choice featuring stunning beachfront views, multiple dining options, and world-class leisure facilities.

Another excellent option is Oaks Ibn Battuta Gate Hotel, 20 minutes away, known for its Arabian-inspired architecture and luxury accommodations. For those seeking a resort-style stay, Lapita, Dubai Parks and Resorts, Autograph Collection provides a Polynesian-themed getaway with exceptional hospitality, located 25 minutes from Badrah. With a variety of hotels catering to different budgets and preferences, visitors can find the perfect stay near the community.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Staying active and maintaining a healthy lifestyle is easy with several fitness facilities located nearby. DP World Swimming Pool, just 7 minutes away, is a great spot for those who enjoy swimming as part of their workout routine. For a full-fledged gym experience, Mia Fitness Center, located 15 minutes away, offers a wide range of cardio and strength training equipment. 

Additionally, Fitness First, a well-known gym chain, has multiple branches in the surrounding areas, providing top-tier fitness programs and personal training sessions.

For beauty and relaxation, Lengths and Lashes Ladies Beauty Salon, situated 13 minutes away, caters to women with a range of services, including haircare, bridal and party makeup, manicures, and pedicures. 

Those looking for spa treatments can visit Feet First Reflexology & Massage Centre or Ola Spa, both located 20 minutes away. Feet First Reflexology specializes in therapeutic foot massages based on reflexology techniques, offering a holistic approach to relaxation and well-being.

Community Events

As Badrah and its parent community continue to grow, large-scale community events are not yet a regular occurrence. However, residents can still enjoy a variety of cultural festivities and social gatherings at nearby destinations. 

Ibn Battuta Mall, located within easy reach, hosts year-round events, seasonal celebrations, and cultural festivals, providing entertainment and engagement for families and individuals alike. As the community expands, more local events and social activities are expected to become part of the lifestyle in Badrah, Dubai Waterfront.

Attractions and Landmarks

For those seeking adventure and entertainment, several exciting attractions are located just minutes away from Badrah. Pursuit Games, 11 minutes from Badrah, is the ultimate destination for paintball enthusiasts, offering multiple game scenarios like Fill the Bucket, Attack and Defend, and Capture the Flag. Known as the best paintball venue in the UAE, it’s perfect for a thrilling group activity.

For shooting sports, JA Shooting Club (Jebel Ali Shooting Club) is just 12 minutes away, featuring both indoor and outdoor shooting ranges. Visitors can test their skills with clay pigeon shooting and indoor target shooting, making it an excellent spot for beginners and experienced marksmen alike.

For a more immersive entertainment experience, Motiongate Dubai, 14 minutes away, offers Hollywood-style performances, thrilling rides, and themed attractions. It is also conveniently located near Bollywood Parks and Legoland, making it a fantastic destination for families and theme park lovers.

Envisioned as a self-sustained urban community, Badrah, Dubai Waterfront is steadily developing, with some sub-districts still under construction. While the population remains low at this stage, the area's strategic location, access to public transportation, and proximity to entertainment hubs ensure a vibrant and convenient lifestyle. 

As development progresses, Badrah is set to become a thriving residential and commercial destination, offering modern living with all essential amenities.

What makes Badrah different from other waterfront communities in Dubai?

Unlike high-end waterfront developments, Badrah, Dubai Waterfront is designed as an affordable, self-sustained community. It offers budget-friendly townhouses and apartments, green open spaces, and essential amenities, making it an ideal choice for families and professionals seeking a peaceful yet well-connected neighborhood.

Where is Badrah located?

Badrah is situated within the Dubai Waterfront area, near Jebel Ali. It offers easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), providing convenient connectivity to central Dubai and neighboring commercial hubs.

What types of properties are available in Badrah?

The community comprises 594 homes, including townhouses and apartments spread across eight low-rise buildings. Residents can enjoy amenities such as a shopping pavilion, kids' play areas, and parks.

Who is the developer of Badrah?

Badrah is developed by Nakheel Properties, a prominent real estate developer in Dubai known for creating integrated and sustainable communities.

data.content:
Nestled within the expansive Dubai Waterfront, Badrah is a well-planned residential and commercial hub developed by Nakheel Properties. Strategically located near Palm Jebel Ali, this community offers a mix of townhouses, apartments, office spaces, and retail outlets, making it a self-sustaining destination. 

With a focus on luxury, Badrah Residence, Dubai Waterfront is designed to cater to families and professionals looking for modern living spaces. The community is divided into four distinct sub-districts—Diaa, Talla, Manara, and Bahaa—each seamlessly connected through a central boulevard. Surrounded by lush green open spaces, Badrah provides a peaceful environment away from the city's hustle and bustle. Its close proximity to Jebel Ali Freezone makes it an ideal choice for professionals working in the area, while its well-planned infrastructure ensures convenience for residents and business owners alike. 

One of the standout features of Badrah Residence, Dubai Waterfront is its excellent connectivity. The community is conveniently linked to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), offering smooth access to Dubai’s key landmarks and business districts. Built to the highest standards in civil engineering, Badrah ensures a comfortable lifestyle with modern amenities and essential facilities, making it a prime choice for those seeking affordable yet well-connected living in Dubai.
